name: hash.fnv
doc:
hash.fnv: FNV-1 and FNV-1a, 32 and 64 bit (Go's hash/fnv). Each
New* returns a value implementing hash.Hash32 / Hash64.

items.name: String64a
items.doc: FNV-1a 64 of s in one call.
items.summary: FNV-1a 64 of s in one call.

items.name: Hash32
items.doc: Hash32 is a 32-bit FNV-1 or FNV-1a hash (New32, New32a).
items.summary: Hash32 is a 32-bit FNV-1 or FNV-1a hash (New32, New32a).

members.name: Write
members.doc: Write adds p to the hash; it never fails.
members.summary: Write adds p to the hash; it never fails.

members.name: WriteString
members.doc: WriteString adds the bytes of s to the hash.
members.summary: WriteString adds the bytes of s to the hash.

members.name: Sum
members.doc: Sum returns the hash as 4 big-endian bytes.
members.summary: Sum returns the hash as 4 big-endian bytes.

items.name: Hash64
items.doc: Hash64 is a 64-bit FNV-1 or FNV-1a hash (New64, New64a).
items.summary: Hash64 is a 64-bit FNV-1 or FNV-1a hash (New64, New64a).

members.name: Write
members.doc: Write adds p to the hash; it never fails.
members.summary: Write adds p to the hash; it never fails.

members.name: WriteString
members.doc: WriteString adds the bytes of s to the hash.
members.summary: WriteString adds the bytes of s to the hash.

members.name: Sum
members.doc: Sum returns the hash as 8 big-endian bytes.
members.summary: Sum returns the hash as 8 big-endian bytes.
